scientific_question: Does the comparator-relative global-policy field fingerprint found sequentially in seeds 2104 and 2105 replicate on two mandatory fresh v1 backbones?
current_theory: P_T-dependent neural global policy carries an additive distance slope. On seeds 2104 and 2105, relative to one frozen exact-posterior comparator, the additive-source effect A and neural-norm posterior-shape reduction Q_shape were materially positive, while the fixed-sigmoid interaction I was materially negative. No single field-component replacement was sufficient. These are sequential comparator-relative field constraints, not yet a replicated fresh-backbone working mechanism.
replication_hypothesis: Under the unchanged field construction, posterior comparator, probability link, participant cohort, masks, estimators, thresholds, and controls, the three-part fingerprint A>0, Q_shape>0, and I<0 will pass separately in both mandatory fresh backbones after the neural-versus-posterior slope anchor D>0 and competence gates pass.
claim_boundary: This is a read-only offline replication of a comparator-relative probability-field fingerprint. It does not retest or establish single-component sufficiency; causally identify P_T, W_out, recurrent dynamics, a circuit interaction, a biological store, or the human posterior; establish network-population prevalence; fit any parameter; or authorize a model intervention. The exact posterior remains a frozen scientific comparator rather than ground truth.
registration_timing: Frozen after the complete seed-2104/2105 field-reassembly result and before writing a replication runner, creating or loading any seed-2106/2107 checkpoint, constructing any seed-2106/2107 Liu condition, or inspecting any seed-2106/2107 outcome. No repository or output path identifying seed 2106 or 2107 existed at registration.

network_seed_contract.participant_inference: Bootstrap all 77 participants separately within each network. Never pool participant rows or bootstrap draws across networks.

v1_backbone_training.held_out_graph: source-correct Liu graph and its rank-axis reflection
v1_backbone_training.checkpoint_selection: final registered step only; intermediate checkpoints are never evaluated

runtime_contract.device: visible CUDA GPU required for backbone training and neural replay
runtime_contract.trial_input_transfer: one contiguous CPU-to-GPU transfer per trial

execution_firewall.implementation_freeze: Commit and push the runner, tests, formal-runtime dispatch, and exact implementation/source lock before training either seed.
execution_firewall.artifact_generation: Train both mandatory final-step backbones in the registered order without invoking the Liu evaluator or inspecting any human outcome.
execution_firewall.joint_artifact_lock: Only after both complete backbone artifact sets exist, write one joint hash lock covering both checkpoints, configs, manifests, and complete training logs; commit and push that lock before evaluation.
execution_firewall.evaluation: Only after the committed joint lock, evaluate both seeds in one command. Seed 2106 may not determine whether seed 2107 is trained, locked, or evaluated.
execution_firewall.repair_boundary: Only an integrity or execution repair that leaves every scientific estimand, threshold, seed, artifact, and outcome rule unchanged may occur; it must be documented and frozen before any affected replay.

posterior_comparator.hypothesis_log_weights: ell_pi=-E(pi)/0.05 from the exact frozen posterior and each participant's realized stable-omission evidence.
posterior_comparator.comparator_boundary: This frozen exact posterior is a scientific comparator, not the human posterior or ground-truth neural geometry.

field_contract.unchanged_estimator: Use the source-locked field_reassembly_estimands implementation without changing any cell, sign, mask, distance, decomposition, link, norm match, or identity.
field_contract.fresh_endpoint_identity: In the same post-lock evaluation, independently compute S_N_direct from sigmoid[y m_N/0.25] and S_P_direct from the exact posterior pair-probability field before any hybrid reassembly. S_NN must equal S_N_direct, S_PP must equal S_P_direct, and D must equal S_N_direct-S_P_direct participant-wise within 1e-10.
field_contract.discovery_artifact_firewall: The seed-2104/2105 discovery result and report are registered provenance only. The replication runner must not load their raw estimands, statuses, or outcomes and must not require a prior Track-B or amplitude result for seeds 2106/2107.
field_contract.edge_order: All 28 unordered item pairs in lexicographic integer order, with both query orientations used to form each antisymmetric neural margin.
field_contract.sign: Canonical edge fields are oriented by the lexicographic pair. Multiply by the frozen source-correct sign y_ij only after field construction.
field_contract.primary_pair_subset: The same 20 nonlearned pairs used by Track B; learned support pairs are excluded before every symbolic-distance slope.
field_contract.neural_condition: Pure L-off replay with intact terminal P_T and frozen W_out; no local trace is constructed or read.
field_contract.hodge_decomposition: For x in {N,P}, s_x=B_plus m_x, g_x=B s_x, and c_x=m_x-g_x on the complete graph in the minimum-norm zero-sum gauge.
field_contract.fixed_sigmoid_boundary: The corresponding four-cell pre-sigmoid margin interaction must be zero within 1e-10. A nonzero I is a fixed-sigmoid probability-field context effect, not a recurrent or circuit interaction.

norm_matched_additive_control.single_registered_direction: Scale posterior additive field to neural additive edge-field norm separately within participant; never scale neural to posterior.
norm_matched_additive_control.equation: g_P_tilde=g_P ||g_N||_2/||g_P||_2 using all 28 canonical edges before correctness signing or nonlearned selection.
norm_matched_additive_control.estimands: S_tildePN=slope_d sigmoid[y(g_P_tilde+c_N)/0.25], Q_shape=S_NN-S_tildePN, C_shape=S_tildePN-S_PP, and Q_amp=S_tildePN-S_PN.

statistical_estimands.subject_slope: Fixed-design OLS cov(p,d)/var(d) over the same 20 nonlearned pairs, separately for every participant and cell.

bootstrap.rule: Use one registered participant-resampling count matrix per network and recompute every cell mean and paired contrast from the same draw. Edges are fixed and never resampled. All 10000 estimates must be finite.

statistical_estimands.mutually_exclusive_status_rule: material_positive requires lower95>+0.005; material_negative requires upper95<-0.005; equivalent requires the entire 90 percent interval inside [-0.005,+0.005]; otherwise unresolved.
statistical_estimands.anchor_rule: D is a prerequisite anchor and passes only when its 95 percent participant-bootstrap lower bound is greater than zero separately in each network; D does not use the materiality margin.
statistical_estimands.network_replication: Every primary link is classified and decided independently in seeds 2106 and 2107. Participant rows, count matrices, and draws are never pooled.

primary_links.anchor_D: Prerequisite only: D lower95>0 separately in both networks.
primary_links.additive_source_A: A is material_positive separately in both networks.
primary_links.norm_matched_shape_Q_shape: Q_shape is material_positive separately in both networks.
primary_links.fixed_sigmoid_interaction_I: I is material_negative separately in both networks.

secondary_boundaries.R: Report point, 90 and 95 percent intervals, mutually exclusive status, and cross-network agreement. Unresolved or nonsignificant R is not a positive replication claim. Equivalence may be reported only if the registered 90 percent equivalence rule passes, and is not primary.
secondary_boundaries.C_A: Report as the natural posterior-additive replacement closure boundary. Material positive C_A in both networks supports replicated nonclosure as a secondary boundary; equivalence or heterogeneity must also be reported and cannot change the primary fingerprint decision.
secondary_boundaries.C_shape: Report as the neural-norm posterior-shape closure boundary under fixed c_N. Material positive C_shape in both networks supports replicated nonclosure as a secondary boundary; equivalence or heterogeneity must also be reported and cannot change the primary fingerprint decision.
secondary_boundaries.other_cells_and_contrasts: Report all frozen four-cell, replacement, norm-match, and identity estimands. Do not select a new sufficiency branch or count algebraically dependent contrasts as independent evidence.

competence_and_integrity_gates.source_and_artifact_hashes: Every registered source, implementation source, checkpoint, config, complete log, manifest, and joint artifact lock must match SHA-256.
competence_and_integrity_gates.formal_runtime: Visible GPU with one PyTorch intra-op and one inter-op CPU thread.
competence_and_integrity_gates.backbone_competence: Each frozen backbone must independently pass qualification_v2 under the registered Liu causal suite before any field result is interpreted.
competence_and_integrity_gates.frozen_parameters: Every backbone tensor hash is identical before and after evaluation.
competence_and_integrity_gates.complete_execution: Both networks, all 77 participants, 28 canonical edges, 56 neural query orientations, the fixed 20 nonlearned pairs, and all 10000 finite bootstrap draws.
competence_and_integrity_gates.fresh_direct_endpoint_identity: S_NN=S_N_direct, S_PP=S_P_direct, and D=S_N_direct-S_P_direct participant-wise within 1e-10, using endpoints computed in the same locked evaluation without any seed-2104/2105 or prior new-seed result.
competence_and_integrity_gates.factorial_identities: All identities frozen in the discovery contract pass participant-wise and bootstrap-wise within 1e-10.
competence_and_integrity_gates.norm_match: Additive norm, reconstruction, zero-sum gauge, gradient, orthogonality, and complete-field energy identities pass within 1e-10.
competence_and_integrity_gates.no_filtering_or_posthoc_repair: No participant, edge, network, seed, field component, mask, comparator, threshold, contrast, or result may be removed, replaced, added, or redefined after execution.

cross_network_decision.noninterpretable_competence_or_integrity: Any competence, source, artifact, runtime, completeness, finiteness, reconstruction, posterior, norm, or identity gate fails in either network.
cross_network_decision.premise_not_confirmed: All competence and integrity gates pass, but D lower95>0 does not pass separately in both networks.
cross_network_decision.link_classification: For each of A, Q_shape, and I: replicated if the expected registered status occurs in both networks; heterogeneous_or_unresolved if either network is unresolved, if the expected status occurs in exactly one network, or if the two resolved statuses differ; otherwise not_replicated, which requires the same resolved nonexpected status in both networks.
cross_network_decision.replicated_field_fingerprint: After competence, integrity, and D gates pass, A and Q_shape are material_positive and I is material_negative separately in both networks.
cross_network_decision.heterogeneous_or_unresolved_fingerprint: After premise confirmation, at least one primary link is heterogeneous_or_unresolved and the complete three-link fingerprint does not replicate.
cross_network_decision.field_fingerprint_not_replicated: After premise confirmation, the complete fingerprint does not replicate and no primary link is classified heterogeneous_or_unresolved.
cross_network_decision.decision_priority: Apply competence/integrity first, D premise second, then the three-link fingerprint. Secondary R and closure boundaries never override the primary outcome.

outcome_contingent_interpretation.replicated_field_fingerprint: The comparator-relative combination of positive additive-source effect, positive neural-norm shape reduction, and negative fixed-sigmoid context interaction is stable across two additional mandatory fresh backbones. This may justify a separately preregistered read-only allocation audit of Delta_g=g_N-g_P_tilde on explicit pair, distance, posterior-uncertainty, and evidence-coverage axes. It still does not establish component sufficiency, network-population prevalence, comparator truth, or a P_T-internal causal mechanism.
outcome_contingent_interpretation.heterogeneous_or_unresolved_fingerprint: Keep the seed-2104/2105 result as a sequential comparator-relative fingerprint, report every preserved within-network link and all heterogeneous or unresolved links, and prioritize a separately registered comparator-adequacy question rather than decomposing or intervening on P_T.
outcome_contingent_interpretation.field_fingerprint_not_replicated: Do not promote the 2104/2105 fingerprint into the global-policy working mechanism. Preserve valid individual links and reassess comparator adequacy under a separate prospective criterion; do not tune the network or add posterior hybrids.
outcome_contingent_interpretation.secondary_nonclosure: If C_A and/or C_shape are materially positive in both fresh networks, report that the corresponding contribution-without-closure boundary replicated secondarily. If either is equivalent in both networks, report a replicated closure-boundary shift, while noting that closure alone is not a sufficiency claim in this contract. If either network is unresolved or the resolved statuses differ, report that secondary boundary as heterogeneous_or_unresolved. None changes the primary outcome.
outcome_contingent_interpretation.R: Report R exactly. Neither repeated non-significance nor unresolved status is evidence that the residual main effect is small.

reporting.next_action: Independently review this specification, then commit and push it before runner implementation or any seed-2106/2107 checkpoint generation or Liu replay.
